izzyondroid:com.github.frimtec.android.s.name: S2MSP
izzyondroid:com.github.frimtec.android.s.summary: SMS communication for apps restricted on phone numbers
izzyondroid:com.github.frimtec.android.s.description:
As Google strongly restricts the use of SMS permissions for applications in the Play-Store, S2MSP provides an API for third party applications to send and receive SMS to specific phone numbers via a secure SMS proxy.
 S2MSP acts like a local firewall for SMS communication.
 Each application that wants to send/receive SMS to a phone number can register itself on S2MSP. S2MSP asks the user for permission, whether the requesting application is allowed to send/receive SMS from and to the requested phone numbers or not.
 All SMS exchanged with third party applications are strongly encrypted.
 S2SMP itself requires SMS permissions ( SEND_SMS and RECEIVE_SMS ) from the Android system and will request these permissions upon startup. S2MSP does not need any other permissions. This ensures the integrity and security of S2MSP.
 The API to integrate a third party application with S2MSP is available in Maven-Central.

izzyondroid:de.tuberlin.mcc.simra.app.name: SimRa
izzyondroid:de.tuberlin.mcc.simra.app.description:
Comparable to other major cities worldwide, Berlin aims to reduce traffic emissions. Foremost mechanism for this is to increase the share of bicycle traffic. However, polls show that a lack of safety and fear of accidents keeps people from using their bikes more frequently. Furthermore, it also quite hard from a city planning perspective to get a good overview of location, time, frequency, and kind of hazards in bicycle traffic since official accident statistics only cover crashes but do not provide information on near crashes.
 In this project, we collect – with a strong focus on data protection and privacy – data on such near crashes to identify when and where bicyclists are especially at risk. We also aim to identify the main routes of bicycle traffic in Berlin. To obtain such data, we have developed the SimRa app that uses GPS information to track routes of bicyclists and the built-in acceleration sensors to pre-categorize near crashes. After their trip, users are asked to annotate and upload the collected data in a fully anonymous way.
 The collected data offers detailed insights into bicycle traffic in Berlin (and other cities) and hazardous situations to public administrators and other interested entities so that the number of near crashes (and hence also crashes) can be reduced. The data can also be used to optimize traffic flows to make bicycle traffic more attractive. For the evaluation of data, we plan to cooperate with interdisciplinary partners such as city planning, interested citizens, but also the Berlin Senate Department for the Environment, Transport and Climate Protection.

fdroid:de.froehlichmedia.adaptkey.summary: Privacy-first Android keyboard that learns your typing style. Fully offline.
fdroid:de.froehlichmedia.adaptkey.description:
AdaptKey is an adaptive Android keyboard (IME) that learns how you type - built for privacy first.
Provably offline. No phoning home.
AdaptKey has no internet permission at all. This is not a promise you have to take on faith - it is enforced by Android and verifiable by anyone: there is no INTERNET permission in the app manifest, so the operating system makes it impossible for the app to open a network connection. No telemetry, no analytics, no "anonymous usage statistics", no ads, no cloud sync.
* No internet permission - kernel-enforced, not a checkbox you trust.
* No storage permission - the optional local AI model is imported through the system file picker, which grants access to just that one file.
* Everything runs on-device. Dictionaries, autocorrect, language detection and the optional mini-LLM all execute locally.
* Free software, licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later - audit every line yourself.
Features
* Gboard-style QWERTZ/QWERTY layout with freely configurable key proportions (space bar, comma, full stop, backspace), a persistent number row, and per-key long-press secondary symbols.
* Learns your touch pattern. A per-key personal offset model adapts hit detection to how you actually tap; an optional calibration step seeds it.
* Smart suggestions and autocorrect from a personal on-device dictionary, with a stabilised suggestion bar, a "keep as typed" escape hatch, and one-tap post-commit undo.
* Real multilingual dictionaries as optional downloadable language packs (German, English and Greek bundled to start with, more to follow), with on-device language detection that switches the whole lexicon per language.
* Greek input with its own layout and accent long-press.
* German capitalisation done right: sentence starts, nouns vs. proper nouns, hyphen segments, the e-mail-salutation comma rule, abbreviations, and a configurable shift-grace window.
* Retroactive fixes: missed-space word split and spurious-space merge, driven by touch ambiguity.
* Gestures: swipe to delete a whole word, swipe down to dismiss, drag a suggestion to trash to blacklist it, word-end shift for casing/camelCase.
* Emoji panel with recents and a live keyword search (English and German).
* Optional on-device mini-LLM (opt-in, work in progress): when the on-device dictionary is uncertain, a small local language model can improve predictions. It is never bundled or downloaded by the app - you import it yourself via the system file picker, and it stays fully offline afterwards.
* Backup and restore your personal learned words, settings and blacklist as a single file.
AdaptKey is under active development. Feedback and bug reports are welcome on the source repository.

fdroid:dev.bikram.obtainx.name: ObtainX
fdroid:dev.bikram.obtainx.summary: A supercharged Obtainium: get Android app updates straight from the source.
fdroid:dev.bikram.obtainx.description:
ObtainX is a modern, supercharged fork of Obtainium. Re-engineered with a stunning Material 3 Expressive UI and power-user utilities that make managing your apps effortless. Get updates straight from the source: GitHub, GitLab, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, APKMirror, APKPure, and more. No central repository, no account, no tracking. 🚀
 ━━ ✨ UNIQUE FEATURES (not in Obtainium) ━━ 
• Build Verification — cryptographic checks (F-Droid/Izzy reproducible builds and GitHub Release Attestations) flag manipulated binaries before install. ObtainX's own updates carry GitHub attestations too.
• Third-Party Installer Support — hand off updates to installers like InstallerX or App Manager to review APK metadata the stock installer hides. Essential under Advanced Protection.
• Bulk Import from Device — select apps already on your phone and ObtainX finds their sources automatically — no URL hunting.
• Dynamic Folders — named folders, manual or rule-based (by name, author, package ID, category, or source); each keeps its own layout.
• On-Demand Only mode — hide rarely-updated apps from the main list and skip them in global scans; check them only when you want.
• Configurable swipe gestures — independent left/right actions per row: Update, Install, Pin, Edit, Delete, and more.
• Custom app icons — set your own icon for any app, from your gallery or the web.
• Undo after delete — swipe- and bulk-delete show a 5-second Undo snackbar.
• Verified "also available on" links — each app shows other stores where it's confirmed present.
• RegEx Assist — a built-in helper walks you through building version and APK filters — no regex knowledge required.
• Know the update size beforehand — see the exact download size before updating.
• Skip Version — pass on a release without marking the app "updated."
• Stop download — cancel any ongoing download from the app, notification, or queue.
• Save assets — save downloaded APKs to a folder of your choice during the update.
 ━━ 🔧 ENHANCED FEATURES ━━ 
• APKMirror updates — enabled (disabled upstream), opening the specific release page.
• Smarter version status — six distinct states instead of a binary update / up-to-date.
• Add App — three paths, one screen — URL, Search, and From Device under one segmented control, results inline.
• Editable package ID for track-only sources — restores correct install detection and updates.
• Active filter chips — a dismissible chip per active filter; tap to clear it.
• Category customization — any color, rename, and bulk assign.
 ━━ 🎨 UI & UX ━━ 
• Adaptive tablet, foldable & landscape layout — on large screens a navigation rail replaces the bottom bar and your app list sits side-by-side with the detail page, opening apps in place. Adding and bulk-importing go two-pane too, and adapt in landscape — so big phones and foldables benefit, not just tablets.
• Material 3 Expressive across every screen — cards, fluid animations, expressive controls.
• A full theme engine — system/light/dark/AMOLED themes, Material You or any hex color, 9 palette algorithms, shading, gradients, progressive blur, corner roundness, and UI scale.
• Per-app color theming derived from each app's own icon.
• Customizable app rows — app type, source, and category at a glance, as text badges or minimal color strips.
• Hero icon transitions, inline collapsible search, inline edit on the detail page, source favicon badges, and auto-hiding action bars.
 ━━ 🔄 BRING YOUR DATA FROM OBTAINIUM ━━ 
In Obtainium, export your app list to a .json file (Import/Export → Export). In ObtainX, open the Backup tab and Import it — your tracked apps populate instantly.
 ━━ 🛡️ FREE & OPEN SOURCE ━━ 
Free and open-source software (GPLv3). Runs entirely on-device — no accounts, no telemetry, no proprietary services.

fdroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.stable.name: InviZible Pro: Tor & Firewall, DNSCrypt & I2P
fdroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.stable.summary: Combine the strengths of Tor, DNSCrypt and I2P for security and anonymity
fdroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.stable.description:
Preserves privacy, prevents tracking, and provides access to restricted and hidden online content. 
 InviZible Pro combines the strengths of Tor, DNSCrypt, and Purple I2P to provide a comprehensive solution for online privacy, security, and anonymity.
 Tor is responsible for privacy and anonymity. It acts like an unlimited free VPN proxy, but does so in the most secure way possible. Tor uses military-grade encryption and routes your internet traffic through a network of volunteer-run proxy servers. This helps protect your identity and location by hiding your IP address. It allows you to browse the internet anonymously, access websites that are otherwise restricted, and communicate privately. Tor also allows access to websites hosted on the Tor network, known as "onion services" or dark web, which are not accessible through regular browsers.
 DNSCrypt is responsible for security. Every phone uses DNS (Domain Name System) when visiting online resources. But this traffic is usually not encrypted and can be intercepted and spoofed by third parties. DNSCrypt ensures that your DNS traffic is encrypted and secure. It prevents unauthorized access and tampering of your DNS queries, providing an additional layer of protection against surveillance and data interception.
 I2P (Invisible Internet Project) provides secure and anonymous access to internal I2P websites, chat forums and other services that are not available through regular browsers. You may know it as the deep web. It works by routing your internet traffic through a network of volunteer-run proxy servers, allowing you to hide your identity and location. I2P provides a secure and private online environment, making it a great option for those who value anonymity and privacy.
 Firewall is a security feature that helps protect your device from unauthorized access and potential threats. It acts as a filter for incoming and outgoing network traffic, allowing you to control which apps can access the internet. By setting up firewall rules, you can choose to block or allow internet connection for individual apps. This helps enhance your privacy and security by preventing unauthorized communication and protecting your data while using your phone.
InviZible Pro can utilize root access, if available on your device, or use a local VPN to deliver internet traffic directly to the Tor, DNSCrypt, and I2P networks.
 Core Features: 
✔ Tor Network - Achieve full anonymity, bypass censorship, and access .onion sites securely
✔ DNSCrypt - Encrypt DNS queries to prevent ISP monitoring and manipulation
✔ I2P (Invisible Internet Project) - Secure and private decentralized networking
✔ Advanced Firewall - Restrict internet access per app and block unauthorized connections
✔ No Root Access Required - Works seamlessly on all devices without modifications
✔ Maintain complete privacy without a paid VPN - Stay anonymous for free
✔ Stealth Mode - Evade Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) and regional restrictions
✔ Free & Open Source - No ads, no tracking, no compromises

 applications are presented in the main window, where each can be enabled
 individually.
 Besides manipulating sound output, PulseEffects is able to apply effects
 to an input device, such as a microphone. This is, for example, useful in
 audio recording, but it also works well during voice conversations.
 When PulseEffects is launched it will conveniently remember the
 configuration used in the last session. It is also possible to save
 all the current settings as profiles.

flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indidatabase.name: indiDatabase
flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indidatabase.summary: Build your own database — no programming required
flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indidatabase.description:
indiDatabase is a desktop database for people who are not programmers, in the tradition of FileMaker
 Pro and Lotus Approach. Design tables, draw forms, save finds, and print reports — everything lives
 in one file on your own computer, and the whole office can work in it together over your own network
 with no server product and no cloud.
 Features include:
 Tables designed point-and-click, with nine field types including exact decimal amounts for
 money
 Forms drawn for each table, with find-by-filling-in-the-form, related-record panels, and
 buttons that run the day's routine
 Six kinds of reports: grouped lists, certificates, Avery label sheets, form letters, crosstabs,
 and charts — with questions asked when a report runs
 Saved finds with found-set counts, and a Summarise mode that groups and totals without a
 formula
 Calculated fields, summary fields over related records, validation rules, starting values,
 and relationships on one field pair or several
 Conditional formatting and named styles, stored in the file so every desk draws the same
 warnings
 A Home dashboard of pinned reports and worksheets, the same on every desk
 Multi-user sharing on your own network: pairing codes, TLS with pinned fingerprints, live
 updates, record locking by name, and a field-by-field merge when two people collide
 Users, roles, record-level and field-level security, and an audit trail stamped by the engine
 Import from CSV and legacy dBase files (including FoxPro-era memo files); export the found
 set to CSV
 Automatic backups with restore points, taken safely while the file is in use
 indiDatabase respects your privacy and works entirely offline. Your database is a single SQLite-backed
 file on your own computer and never leaves your machine.

flathub:fi.skyjake.Lagrange.name: Lagrange
flathub:fi.skyjake.Lagrange.description:
Lagrange is a versatile client for browsing Geminispace. It offers modern conveniences familiar

flathub:sa.sy.bluerecorder.description: A simple desktop recorder for Linux systems. Built using Rust, GTK+ 4 and ffmpeg. It supports recording audio and video on almost all Linux interfaces with support for Wayland display server on GNOME session. firefox-addons:2725513.name: Google Translate Engine
firefox-addons:2725513.summary: OpenSearch engine for Google Translate including suggestions aka autocompletion.
firefox-addons:2725513.description:
A Google Translate search engine integrated with Google's autocomplete API via x-suggestions. Like other good OpenSearch engines for Firefox, it will guess what you're trying to type and offer common completions to display in the search/url bar results. Since search engines can only pass a single user-defined parameter, the query, the other parameters are predefined. This means the source language and target language are both always set to auto.
So you begin typing a given query that you want to translate such as "trad" and Google will guess that the input language is Spanish, and then will guess that you want to type something like "traductor" or "traducir" and will offer these as autocomplete suggestions. If you click one of them, it will navigate to Google Translate with the chosen query typed into the input box.
Google Translate will then guess the target language (the language into which you're trying to translate the query) based on your previous behavior on Google Translate, or perhaps if you have a Google account it will choose whatever Google's big brother identity tracking system has deduced to be your primary language. If you usually use English or if English was the most recent target language you manually selected on translate.google.com , it will translate "traductor" into English and you'll get "translator" as your result.
This extension also includes a custom icon with context properties so it can be made to look good with both light and dark themes.

Boyfriendtv Downloader gives creators and teams a dependable way to save BoyfriendTV videos for offline access. Instead of juggling manual captures or scattered tools, it pulls publicly accessible files directly from BoyfriendTV with consistent quality. Use it to archive research material, prep client deliverables, or keep your personal library available when you're traveling or working with limited connectivity.
Key features:
- One-click downloads from BoyfriendTV
- Preserves original quality and metadata
- Batch queue with automatic retries
- Local-first workflows with no tracking
- Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Use this product only with videos you own, manage, or have permission to save. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the source platform.
Product page: https://serp.ly/boyfriendtv-downloader

firefox-addons:2896848.name: taba11y – Tab order accessibility tester
firefox-addons:2896848.description:
taba11y calculates the tab order of all elements and displays it visually, either by drawing a path or by highlighting the elements. It has many options to suit every situation.
Tab order is important for a wide range of users, from keyboard-only to screenreader users. By ensuring that the tab order is logical, you can provide a great user experience for as many people as possible.

firefox-addons:2937921.name: Doorzo ‑ Direct Shopping
firefox-addons:2937921.summary: Shop from 60+ Japanese sites in one cart with Doorzo – Direct Shopping.
firefox-addons:2937921.description:
Doorzo – Direct Shopping
Cross-border shopping made simple.
Doorzo – Direct Shopping is a desktop browser extension developed by the Doorzo team, allowing you to quickly shop on popular Japanese websites using Doorzo's proxy service. With just one click, add items to your cart and check out seamlessly across multiple sites.
Key Features
🛍️ Supports 60+ Japanese sites: Including JDirectItems Auction, Rakuten, Rakuma, Amazon, Mercari, and more.
🧩 Cross-site integration: Add items from different sites into one Doorzo cart and place a single order.
⚡ Real-time operation: No need to switch platforms — add items to Doorzo while browsing.
How to Use
1️⃣ Install the Doorzo – Direct Shopping extension
2️⃣ Open a Japanese shopping website and go to a product page
3️⃣ Click the “Doorzo – Direct Shopping” button
4️⃣ Select item specs and add to cart
5️⃣ Click the cart icon to review item details
6️⃣ Submit your order request
Shipping & Service
📦 Consolidated shipping: Items from different sites can be shipped together.
🚚 Flexible delivery options: After items arrive at our warehouse, choose to consolidate orders, set the delivery method and address, and we’ll ship them out.
🌏 Multilingual customer support: Support in English, Chinese, and Japanese – no language barriers.
Why Doorzo?
✅ 10 years of proxy experience — our expert team carefully handles every order
✅ Official partner of top Japanese shopping platforms
✅ Full-service support from purchase to international shipping
Doorzo – Direct Shopping is built for global users, making it easy to shop for Japanese goods from home with peace of mind and transparent service.

firefox-addons:3048765.name: Hudu Password Manager
firefox-addons:3048765.summary: Get more out of Hudu with Hudu Password Manager, your browser-based tool for faster, safer access to your Hudu passwords right from any tab. Built to fit seamlessly into your workflow, Hudu Password Manager keeps your credentials a click away.
firefox-addons:3048765.description:
With Hudu Password Manager, you can:
* Autofill usernames and passwords directly into login forms
* Access passwords and quickly copy usernames, passwords, and OTPs
* Search your Hudu password vault from anywhere in the browser
* Generate strong passwords on the fly

firefox-addons:887150.name: Password Hasher NG
firefox-addons:887150.summary: Password Hasher NG is the convenient and secure way to have different passwords on all sites. Updated version of the legacy Password Hasher.
firefox-addons:887150.description:
Password Hasher NG is the convenient and secure way to have different passwords on all sites. Simply remember the masterkey and password hasher will generate a unique password based on your settings without ever storing your passwords.
For more information: https://github.com/phreaknerd/passhash-ng 
Includes a standalone html-version based on https://github.com/redcatjs/passhash-ng-html

Your privacy is non-negotiable. KYMS gives you control, speed, and peace of mind — all in one place.

apple-itunes:1467861203.description:
Ships of Glory is a mobile free-to-play naval action simulator.
Command your battleship as a third person shooter and plan your battlefield war strategy.
Take command of a variety of ships from the World War 1 and World War 2 era including Patrol Boats, Destroyers, Cruisers, Battleships, Dreadnoughts, Submarines and Aircraft Carriers.
The only rules of this game is that there are no rules! Battle with friends or go it alone. The choice is yours.
Run escort for your allies cargo or passenger missions and be rewarded should they deem you worthy!
Sneak up on your opponents in one of 3 submarine types before unloading your torpedo's!
Lay a minefield with the mine laying cruiser!
Use depth charges or hedgehogs on enemy subs!
Strategically get in position and fire deadly broadside attacks!
Lead enemies into the firepower of your allied forces!
You can even fly the pirate flag to put the fear of the seas into your opponents!
Train up on the low tier training server before taking on massive action in the main battle server.
Good Luck Captain!
